Custom glass pricing depends on several factors. We provide free, itemized written estimates for every project. Contact us to schedule a free site visit and quote. Can you fabricate glass into any shape or size? Yes. We custom-cut glass to virtually any dimension or shape. If your design calls for it, we can cut it. We work from measurements, sketches, CAD drawings, or on-site measurements taken by our team. How long does custom glass fabrication take? We typically fabricate and install most residential custom glass projects within three to seven business days after you approve the estimate. Larger commercial or architectural projects involving specialty materials or multi-phase installations may require five to 14 business days. We provide a specific timeline with every written estimate. What's the difference between tempered and laminated glass? Tempered glass is heat-treated for strength and shatters into small, relatively safe fragments when broken. Utah’s code for glass installation requires it for shower enclosures, glass doors, floor panels, and railings. Laminated glass uses a bonding interlayer so fragments stay in place when broken. Our team will recommend the right type for your specific project during the estimate consultation. Do you work with interior designers and architects? Yes. We regularly collaborate with interior designers, architects, and general contractors on residential and commercial projects. We work from CAD drawings, design specifications, and mood boards. We provide samples, detailed fabrication timelines, and clear communication throughout the project to keep your design schedule on track. Can you match glass to an existing installation or replicate a specific style? In most cases, yes. Bring us a sample, a photo, or a description of the glass you’re trying to match, and we’ll source or fabricate the closest match available. We have access to an extensive range of glass types and specialty materials. Does a warranty cover custom glass? Yes.
